canonical_data: Local memoir store addressed by hierarchical semantic paths with a Git-like commit history
strengths: Fully local Python package with no cloud dependency (pip install memoir-ai)
Applies Git-like blame, checkout, branch, merge, and rollback semantics directly to individual memory records
Ships as installable plugins for multiple coding-agent hosts (Claude Code, Codex) in addition to a standalone CLI and SDK
weaknesses: The project labels its own status Alpha and remains pre-1.0 more than a year after creation
O(log n) lookup and cryptographic-integrity claims are asserted in the README with no independent benchmark
Single maintainer with no published research paper or company backing, unlike comparable agent-memory services
why_it_matters: Tests whether Git-style versioning of agent memory can work as a lightweight local library instead of a hosted vector-database service.
